exportOrders.title: Export orders and containers
exportOrders.subtitle: Export orders in the buyer's currency, containers and packing lists, and the export invoice
exportOrders.noView: You do not have the right to see export orders. Ask Admin.
exportOrders.emptyBody: Shipped containers come across from your records through Admin › Import data; new orders start here.
exportOrders.noCreate: You do not have the right to create export orders.
exportOrders.noBuyers: No overseas buyer for this company yet. Add the buyer on Sales → Customers with GST status "overseas".

f.fxHelp: The rate you record for this order; the invoice converts with it.
f.rateHelp: Rates in the order's currency, per unit.

c.title: Containers and packing lists
c.noEdit: You do not have the right to add containers.
c.noHelp: 4 letters and 7 digits; the last digit is a check digit and the server checks it.
c.diff: {{item}}: list {{lc}} cartons / {{lp}} pieces, loaded {{dc}} cartons / {{dp}} pieces
c.mismatch: Loading does not match the packing list; the differences are listed.

i.title: Export invoices
i.noRight: You need export and invoice rights to post the export invoice.
i.lutHint: Only Admin posts an export under LUT. Untick to post with IGST.
i.lutHintAdmin: You are Admin: the server checks the LUT is valid on the invoice date.
i.rule: Rates in the order's currency × its recorded exchange rate = rupees. Under LUT the invoice is zero-rated (open question Q-P6-3 for the CA) and posted by Admin only; without LUT it carries IGST with place of supply 96. Every invoice goes into the books, the returns and the CA's view.

order.title: Export order.
order.body: Buyer, port, models and quantities, price and currency, container type, ship date.

plan.title: Material plan.
plan.body: Bill of materials × quantity, less stock: purchase requests per supplier.

assembly.title: Assembly and QC.
assembly.body: Assembly orders with staff duties, so labour per piece is measured.

packing.title: Packing.
packing.body: Colour box, master carton, carton numbers, labels, QC sticker.

stuffing.title: Packing list and stuffing.
stuffing.body: Cartons are checked into the container against the packing list.

documents.title: Documents.
documents.body: Commercial invoice under LUT, packing list, shipping bill details, bill of lading, certificate of origin.

goods.title: Other goods in the container.
goods.body: Own goods in the same container go on the same export invoice and packing list, each line with its own HSN.

payment.title: Payment.
payment.body: Buyer payment matched in the bank, with the bank realisation certificate against each shipping bill.
